problem_type: Caught renderer failures bypass diagnostic ownership
symptom: Three direct console calls fail lint and omit failure details from packaged diagnostic logs; two unused values and one stable-ref dependency produce avoidable warnings.
direct_cause: Three resource boundaries write directly to console instead of the existing rendererLog owner.
class_root: Equivalent caught asset failures do not consistently converge on the renderer failure-evidence boundary.
affected_population: Scene3D environment, mannequin and generated-model loading failures
internal_only_reason: Existing repository logging API and current source prove both DevTools visibility and forwarding to the diagnostic bridge; no external or dependency behavior changes.
invariants: Warning/error severity, original Error, code and stack survive reporting
Fallback and environment reset behavior remain unchanged

door_reduction.why_not: Three distinct resource boundaries must retain their own fallback/reset lifecycles; they converge only at the existing rendererLog diagnostic owner. Unrelated scanned doors remain unchanged.

generality_proof: All three resource-failure consumers use the existing shared reporting API. Source-driven class tests invoke each real catch and fallback path with the real rendererLog owner and an isolated transport sink, validating local visibility, severity and serialized error evidence.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Existing unchanged owner preserves local visibility and forwards structured error evidence to the main diagnostic log
